title: Rebind capture stores shifted symbols instead of the physical key
body:
## Summary
normalizeKeyEvent maps KeyboardEvent.key, so Shift+1 captures '!' and Shift+- captures '_': labels no keycap, conflict check or EKeys name knows.

## Description
src/lib/character/input-bindings.ts:129 normalizes `e.key` (layout- and modifier-dependent) rather than `e.code`. src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/input/InputBindingsTable.tsx:164 feeds it straight into setBindingOverride. A designer who holds Shift while pressing 1 gets a binding to '!', which never collides with 'Force Power 1' on '1' and is emitted to the Apply prompt as EKeys::! . Fixed = derive the label from `e.code` (Digit1 -> '1', Minus -> '-', KeyQ -> 'Q') with `e.key` only as fallback. The file is outside this context (lib/character), so Lane B.

## Flow
- click a Key cell in Input Bindings
- press Shift+1
- table shows '!', the keyboard map shows it in the Other row, no conflict with Force Power 1

## Expected impact
Designers holding a modifier or on non-US layouts stop getting phantom bindings; risk: AZERTY users whose e.key differs from e.code would see the US label.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - captured label equals the physical key
Before: Shift+1 -> '!' (walked from normalizeKeyEvent source; 1 of 1 shifted digit wrong)
After: Shift+1 -> '1'
Method: simulation - the lib file is outside this round's paths, so the probe was not run
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest: fire keyDown {key:'!', code:'Digit1', shiftKey:true} during a rebind; assert the override is '1'

title: PropertiesMetric reads static comparison stats, not the inspector's feel stack
body:
## Summary
The Features-tab metric for the Property Inspector section shows HP/Speed/Armor from COMPARISON_CHARACTERS, so an Inspector edit never moves it.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/metrics/BlueprintMetrics.tsx:86-110 PropertiesMetric reads the COMPARISON_CHARACTERS 'player' values; the surface it summarises (src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/overview/PropertyInspector.tsx:26) is inspectorRows over the persisted feel stack. CameraMetric in the same file was migrated to the feel stack (11369a0e) and Optimizer/Dodge followed this round (c94900fe). Fixed = derive the metric from inspectorRows (e.g. modified/total, or MaxWalkSpeed/BaseDamage/ArmLength bars). Which values to show is a design pick, hence B.

## Flow
- Overview -> Property Inspector: drag MaxWalkSpeed 320 -> 450
- Features tab: the properties card 'Spd' bar is unchanged (player Speed 600)

## Expected impact
The Features card tells the truth about the section it summarises; risk: card layout change.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - metric follows the surface it summarises
Before: 0 of 1 inspector edits move the metric
After: 1 of 1
Method: simulation - the choice of values needs a design pick before a test can pin it
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: render test: setInspectorOverride('MaxWalkSpeed', 450), then PropertiesMetric text/bar reflects it

title: Hitbox layer exit animations never run (no AnimatePresence)
body:
## Summary
Toggling a hitbox layer off snaps it away although every shape declares an exit animation.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/overview/HitboxWireframeViewer.tsx:56 filters zones with `.filter(z => toggles[z.type])` and the motion.rect/ellipse shapes declare `exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.8 }}`, but no AnimatePresence wraps them (the only AnimatePresence wraps the toggle buttons), so exit is dead code. Fixed = wrap the zone shapes in <AnimatePresence> (or delete the exit props).

## Flow
- Overview -> Hitbox Wireframe: click the 'Hitbox' toggle off
- shapes vanish in one frame; enabling animates them in

## Expected impact
Symmetric toggle feedback; risk: none beyond the visual.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - toggle-off animates like toggle-on
Before: 2 exit declarations, 0 ever run
After: 2 of 2 run
Method: simulation - jsdom cannot observe framer exit timing
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/overview/HitboxWireframeViewer.tsx:56 HITBOX_ZONES.filter(z => toggles[z.type]).map(...) with exit props on each shape
instrument: browser probe or framer test-utils: count shapes still mounted 50ms after toggle-off (expect >0 with AnimatePresence)

title: Keycap aria-label sits on a role-less div
body:
## Summary
Each keyboard-map keycap names itself via aria-label on a generic motion.div, which ARIA prohibits; assistive tech may drop the name.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/input/KeyboardKey.tsx:39 sets aria-label on a div with no role. axe reports this as aria-prohibited-attr; the existing tests (getByLabelText) pass only because testing-library does not enforce the prohibition. Fixed = role="img" (or a list/listitem structure) so the name is permitted.

## Flow
- screen reader browses the Input Binding Map
- keycaps may be announced without their binding (implementation-dependent)

## Expected impact
The keyboard map becomes usable non-visually; risk: none.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every keycap name sits on a role that permits it
Before: 40 keycaps named on a generic element
After: 0
Method: simulation - no axe runner in the round's targeted gate set
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Class-tree header-file tooltip is mouse-only
body:
## Summary
The headerFile tooltip on each class node appears only on mouseenter; keyboard users cannot reach the header path.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/overview/ClassHierarchy.tsx:88-91 sets hovered via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave on a non-focusable motion.div; the tooltip is the only place the header file path is shown. Fixed = make the chip focusable (tabIndex=0) with onFocus/onBlur mirroring hover, or render the path as visible text.

## Flow
- Tab through the Overview tab
- no element on a class chip takes focus; the header path is never shown

## Expected impact
Header paths reachable by keyboard; risk: one extra tab stop per node (4).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - header path reachable without a mouse
Before: 0 of 4 node tooltips reachable by keyboard
After: 4 of 4
Method: simulation - straightforward, but adds tab stops, a UX call
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/overview/ClassHierarchy.tsx:88 onMouseEnter={() => setHovered(true)}; tooltip gated on hovered && node.headerFile
instrument: render test: focus the ACharacter chip, assert the header path text is present

title: Input table shows a fabricated 0% frequency for 10 of 16 actions
body:
## Summary
KEY_FREQUENCY_MAP has 6 hand-entered values; every other binding renders a 0% heat bar, presented as data.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/_shared/data.ts:133-144 hard-codes WASD/Mouse/LMB/E/Space/Shift; src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/input/InputBindingsRow.tsx:258 defaults to 0, so Force Power 1-6, Quick Item 1-2, Force Focus and Heavy Attack show '0%' as if measured. No telemetry source exists. Fixed = render an em dash (unmeasured) for absent entries, or label the column 'Est. frequency'.

## Flow
- Input tab -> Input Bindings table
- Frequency column: 10 rows at 0%

## Expected impact
Designers stop reading 'never pressed' into an unmeasured number; risk: the column looks emptier.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - no unmeasured value rendered as a measurement
Before: 10 of 16 rows show a fabricated 0%
After: 0 of 16
Method: probe - counted INPUT_BINDINGS default keys against KEY_FREQUENCY_MAP's 6 entries
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: render test over InputTab counting Frequency cells with text '0%' (before 10, after 0)

title: Switching wizard source mid-dispatch orphans the running step
body:
## Summary
Picking another source while a step's CLI task runs resets every step to idle and drops the attribution, so the running task's result is never shown.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/wizard/CharacterSourceWizard.tsx:72-86 pickSource resets steps and activeStepRef even while isRunning; handleComplete (:47) then returns early (step null). The session keeps running with all steps 'idle' and no StepResult. Fixed = disable the source picker while isRunning, or keep the in-flight step's attribution.

## Flow
- Wizard: click Prepare Source
- while it runs, click Mixamo
- the rail resets to Step 1, no spinner, and the eventual completion is discarded

## Expected impact
No silent loss of a dispatched result; risk: the source picker is briefly locked.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every dispatched step reports its outcome
Before: 1 of 1 walked mid-run switch loses the outcome
After: 0
Method: simulation - walked the handlers; a test needs a useModuleCLI mock that captures onComplete
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest with a useModuleCLI mock capturing onComplete: dispatch, switch source, call onComplete(true); assert a visible outcome or a disabled picker

title: Camera Profiles panel is static while the feel stack owns the camera
body:
## Summary
The Overview 'Camera Profiles' radar shows six hard-coded 0-1 profiles unrelated to the resolved camera (armLength/fovBase/lagSpeed) that Inspector, CameraMetric and Apply use.

## Description
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/_shared/data.ts:208-217 CAMERA_PROFILES are literal arrays; src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_character/overview/CameraProfileComparison.tsx renders them with no store read, while CameraMetric and the Inspector's Camera column read resolveStack. Whether the panel should become a view of FEEL_PRESETS' camera blocks or be labelled illustrative is a product call.

## Flow
- Inspector: change FOV 80 -> 100
- the Camera Profiles panel is unchanged

## Expected impact
Either the panel shows real camera data or stops implying it does; risk: changes what the panel is.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - the panel reflects the project's camera
Before: 0 of 3 camera fields connected
After: 3 of 3 if connected
Method: simulation - the outcome depends on a product decision
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
instrument: n/a - direction: connect to FEEL_PRESETS camera, or mark illustrative
